task_title: Remediate critical review findings on the whole-English canon curation
result: PASS — all six review findings are resolved: cross-book key collisions and conflicting profiles are zero, canon-level validation exists and passes, coverage is per annotation class and no longer overclaims, and the locked Nehemiah 2 identities and content are bridged and preserved.

cross_book_key_collisions.before: 1,084 attestation keys, 801 mention keys and 2 relationship keys reused across books because keys omitted the book.
cross_book_key_collisions.after: Keys carry the book OSIS. Cross-book collisions: 0 (tools/validate_canon.py).

conflicting_profiles.before: 1,388 profile keys appeared in multiple book packages with different text.
conflicting_profiles.after: Profiles are canon-scoped and emitted once, in the entity's home book (Nehemiah for locked identities); the same profile_key never repeats. Conflicting profiles: 0; 4,284 profiles.

book_local_validation.before: Validation was per-book, so canon-wide defects passed.
book_local_validation.after: tools/validate_canon.py reads all 66 packages together and fails on cross-book key reuse, conflicting canon-scoped records, identity splits and coverage gaps. It passes: 0 collisions, 0 conflicts, identity unified.

coverage_overclaim.before: 18,838 verses were 'complete_zero' with no indication that only attestations/mentions were attempted.
coverage_overclaim.after: Per-class results: canonical_entity_attestation 18,831 complete_zero / 12,255 complete_with_records; translation_mention 20,251 / 10,835. Nine classes (objects, roles, practices, terms, themes, chronology, historical context, localized names, map/timeline) are marked not_attempted and are not claimed complete.

nehemiah_2_identity_split.before: 0 of 31 locked Neh2 identities existed in the registry; 9 had same-name registry counterparts (Jerusalem, Susa, Beyond-the-River, Nehemiah, Artaxerxes, Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, the gates).
nehemiah_2_identity_split.after: The locked identity is canonical: 11 registry entities (persons/places/gates) were renamed onto the locked keys, and 20 locked-only identities (structures, polity, collectives, roles, objects, practices, deity, unnamed queen) were added to the registry. Registry now has 4,295 entities; locked entities not in registry: 0; name splits: 0. tools/locked_neh2.py holds the bridge.

nehemiah_2_content_not_preserved.before: The whole-book Neh package regenerated Nehemiah 2 generically; profiles were 'named in Nehemiah' and the chapter context was generic.
nehemiah_2_content_not_preserved.after: The locked Neh2 canonical/edition/locale records are merged into the whole-book Nehemiah package (tools/locked_neh2.py): 33 claims, 56 citations, 6 curated passage boundaries, curated contexts, and rich profiles (Jerusalem, Nehemiah, cupbearer, gates, ...). Locked records win on collision; scope keys are re-scoped to the whole-book scheme where the range matches.

uncurated_dimensions.detail: Objects, roles, practices, terms, themes, chronology and meaningful historical context remain uncurated because the allowed inputs do not support them and inventing them is forbidden. They are marked not_attempted in the coverage register and flagged by tools/validate_canon.py.

files_changed: tools/curate_canon_queue.py (book-scoped keys; canon-scoped profiles; home-book profile emission; per-class coverage)
tools/locked_neh2.py (new: identity bridge + locked Neh2 merge)
content/curated/canonical|edition|locale/*.v2.json (66 books regenerated; Neh carries locked content)

stop_condition: Stopped after the approved identity bridge and locked-content merge were implemented, the full canon regenerated, and both the canon-level validator and the Zod contract tests passed. No review, approval or publication was performed.
